_doc: Manifest for the ARM200F results page (analysis/make_arm_page.py). Each run is found by its TAG (an analysis tarball's summary.csv label / figdata/<tag> / atomfind_<tag>) and its LEG (the recon dir name recon_af_<leg>_NL<n>: phase render, kick record, error trace), searched in every folder of search_dirs (analysis/*/ and results/ inside each). A run whose tag is not found yet is drawn as 'pending' with its 'pending' text. To fill the page in: pull the tarballs into one of search_dirs (or add the folder here), then rerun make_arm_page.py. See aberration_experiment/page/ARM_PAGE.md.
